description: Converts <dataType> value to double. A string is read as XML Schema double text: digits with an optional sign, decimal point, and exponent ("5", ".5", "5.", "007.5", "1e3"), INF, +INF, -INF, or NaN. Other text, including leading or trailing spaces, is an error. Only text is read this way: an integer value is never silently a double.

errorsThrown.reason: value is not valid double text
